name: aibuilder
description: AI website builder for European small businesses, running end-to-end on Cloudflare.

scripts.bootstrap: wrangler whoami && node --eval "console.log('Account confirmed. Cloudflare resource creation stays manual on purpose: D1 jurisdiction, R2 jurisdiction and Durable Object jurisdiction are all immutable after creation. Follow README.md > Bootstrap, one command at a time.')"
scripts.migrate:cp:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply aibuilder-cp --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:cp:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply aibuilder-cp --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:shard:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply aibuilder-shard-000 --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:shard:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply aibuilder-shard-000 --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
